steps.action: Hold the cube still, then perform one deliberately slow regrip while watching your index finger; note the exact moment it loses contact with the cube, then repeat once and confirm the same lift point.
steps.reason: Slowing the regrip makes the finger's release moment easy to see and compare across two passes.

steps.action: Start another slow regrip, freeze mid-motion at the instant your index finger leaves the cube, check that the fingertip is visibly clear of the surface, then finish the regrip and repeat once.
steps.reason: Freezing at the release instant verifies the exact moment rather than guessing it after the fact.

4.answer: Mira, please try both drills on Friday.

steps.action: Set a comfortable grip, perform one very slow regrip while watching the index finger, and freeze at the first visible loss of contact; reset and repeat twice, noting the exact instant each time.
steps.reason: Slow motion plus a freeze makes the release moment easy to see.

steps.action: Regrip slowly again, pause at the suspected release point to confirm whether the fingertip still touches, then adjust the pause earlier or later until the break is pinpointed.
steps.reason: Pausing at the suspected break confirms the exact contact loss instead of guessing.

inputs.quote: 看看右拇指是不是在换握尚未完成时就离开

steps.action: 用慢速完成一次换握，眼睛盯住右拇指，在换握到位前停半秒，观察它是否提前离开。
steps.reason: 放慢动作并短暂停顿，更容易看清右拇指离开的时机。

steps.action: 把换握分成两段：先让右手到位并停住，再让右拇指离开，重复几次并与自然换握对比。
steps.reason: 分段定格能确认右拇指是否在换握完成前就离开。
